## Campus IT service portal {#campus-it-services}

::: {.contribution authors="unknown" status="unverified"}

If these resources are entirely new to you, spend a few minutes exploring them. Simply knowing what is available may be helpful later.

1.  University IT services: <https://guide.xjtlu.edu.cn/it-guide-for-student.html>, including free Office 365.

2.  Readers are welcome to add more!

:::

## XJTLU virtual desktop {#campus-it-virtual-desktop}

::: {#xp-guide-campus-vm}
:::

::: {.contribution authors="unknown" status="unverified"}

<https://vdi.xjtlu.edu.cn/portal/webclient/index.html> If you are off campus and need quick, temporary access to university resources or software, you can use the university's online virtual desktop. It is effectively a computer located on campus.

:::
